stem: A frequency distribution has the values $x$ = {=c}, {=2*c}, {=3*c}, {=4*c}, {=5*c}, which occur with frequencies $k$ = {=f[0]}, {=f[1]}, {=f[2]}, {=f[3]}, {=f[4]} respectively. Find the mean $\bar{x}$ of this distribution.
notes: All datasets have mean 3c (integer). Answer is whole number. PIPELINE NORMALISATION (not an author edit): the parent expl:pp3u3-2-3:bk-drill-1 became the book question q:pp3u3-2-3:bk-drill-1 when compile learned to mark its answer; re-pointed.
